title: Register Customer
notes: Always creates a customer. Supplying role=admin does not grant privileges. A duplicate email returns 422. Password and confirmation must match; passwords are never returned.

title: Log In
notes: Unknown email, wrong password, and disabled account return 422, not 401. A successful token expires after 30 days.

title: Log Out
notes: Revokes the current bearer token. Subsequent requests with that token must return 401. Remove the device registration first if signing out on a shared device.

title: Browse and Search Carts
notes: Coordinates must be supplied together. Without coordinates this is a catalog search; radius alone does not filter by proximity. With coordinates, results exclude stale/missing locations and sort by distance_meters. Only approved carts with active owners are public. Page is framework pagination, not a validated domain field; use positive integers. Page beyond the last page returns an empty data array.

title: Get Cart Details
notes: Unknown, pending, rejected, or disabled-owner carts return 404. Location can be null.

title: List Cart Updates
notes: Cart must be publicly visible; otherwise 404. Returns only this cart’s updates, newest first.

title: Get My Profile
notes: The current account is derived from the token. No user_id parameter is accepted. Password, remember token, and bearer token are not returned.

title: Update My Profile
notes: Only name is editable. Email, role, and is_active are ignored on this path.

title: Get My Notification Settings
notes: Creates default settings if missing.

title: Update My Notification Settings
notes: 200 when the settings row already exists; 201 if this request creates it. Fields are independently optional; omitted settings keep their values. JSON true/false or 0/1 are accepted; strings "true" and "false" are not Laravel boolean values.

title: Publish My Location
notes: 201 on first creation, 200 on later updates. The server sets updated_at, including repeated identical positions. Client timestamps and user_id are ignored.

title: Delete My Location
notes: Removes only the authenticated user’s location. Repeating deletion still returns 204.

title: List My Followed Carts
notes: Returns only active follows for the current user, with visible cart details. Hidden carts and disabled owners are excluded.

title: List Updates from Followed Carts
notes: Returns activity from the current user’s followed visible carts, with related cart data. Includes existing activity even when the follow was created later.

title: Register Push Device
notes: 201 for a new token; 200 when updating an existing token. Re-registering the same token does not create a second device. Registration transfers the token to the current user if previously registered by another account. Token and token_hash are hidden in responses. The example token is synthetic; keep PUSH_DRIVER=disabled for manual tests.

title: Remove Push Device
notes: Unknown device or a device owned by another user returns 404.

title: List My Notifications
notes: Private inbox, newest first. It must never expose another user’s messages.

title: Mark Notification Read
notes: Unknown notification or another user’s notification returns 404. Repeating updates read_at to the current time.

title: Mark All My Notifications Read
notes: Marks unread messages for the current user only. Already-read timestamps are preserved. Empty inbox also returns 204.

title: Report a Cart or User

note.example: The cart is no longer at this location.

notes: target_id must exist in the table selected by target_type; unknown target returns 422. For a user report use target_type=user and target_id=102. Reporter identity and initial open status are server-owned. Creation may omit database-default status in the immediate response; the persisted report is open.

payload.note: The cart is no longer at this location.

title: Follow Cart
notes: 201 when a follow record is first created, 200 for an existing record (the shared fixture already follows cart 401). Repeating does not duplicate the row. Hidden/unknown carts return 404.

title: Unfollow Cart
notes: Sets is_following=false and retains the row. Repeating, or unfollowing an existing cart with no prior follow, returns 204. Unknown cart returns 404 through route binding. A hidden existing cart can still be unfollowed.

title: List My Owned Carts
notes: Includes pending and rejected carts owned by the authenticated account. Admin callers also see only their own carts on this path; use GET /admin/carts for all carts.

title: Create Food Cart
notes: owner_id comes from the token. moderation_status and is_featured cannot be set here. Minimum payload is name; status defaults to closed.

title: Update Food Cart
notes: All fields are optional. Nullable description/cuisine can be cleared with null. Another owner receives 403; unknown cart receives 404. Administrators can edit any cart.

title: Delete Food Cart
notes: Deletes the cart, related records, and photo files. Use disposable fixture data. Another owner receives 403. Repeating after deletion returns 404.

title: Publish Cart Location
notes: 201 if no location exists, 200 when updating (fixture cart 401 already has one). Identical submissions refresh updated_at. address can be null. Another owner receives 403.

title: Publish Cart Activity Update
notes: Pending or rejected cart returns 403, as does another owner. Omitted type persists as announcement. The scheduler later creates follower notifications; this endpoint does not synchronously send FCM.

title: Save Cart Schedule or One-off Stop
notes: 201 for a new cart/weekday/date key, 200 for an existing key. Monday=1 through Sunday=7. Omit specific_date or send null for a weekly entry. Optional coordinates must be supplied together when non-null. Closing before opening is allowed for overnight hours; equal times are currently allowed. Date/weekday consistency is not currently validated.

title: Delete Cart Schedule
notes: Another owner gets 403. A nonexistent schedule or a schedule belonging to a different cart gets 404.

title: Upload Cart Photo
notes: Use multipart/form-data, not JSON; let curl set the multipart boundary. Maximum file size is 5120 KB and maximum photos per cart is 10. Invalid content, SVG, or an eleventh photo returns 422. A proxy/PHP request-size limit can return 413 before Laravel validation. Another owner receives 403.

title: Delete Cart Photo
notes: Deletes the photo row and stored file. Another owner gets 403. Missing photo or photo on a different cart returns 404.

title: Admin — List Users
notes: Search matches name, not email. Customer and owner tokens return 403. Passwords and remember tokens are hidden.

title: Admin — Change User Role or Status
notes: All fields optional. Disabling revokes that user’s API tokens and hides their carts from public discovery. Disabling or demoting the current administrator returns 422. Unknown user returns 404.

title: Admin — List All Carts
notes: Includes approved, pending, rejected, and disabled-owner carts. No search/status filter is implemented on this path.

title: Admin — Moderate or Feature Cart
notes: All fields optional. Does not allow changing owner, name, or location. Unknown cart returns 404.

title: Admin — List Reports
notes: Omit status for all reports. Invalid status returns 422. No reporter or target filter is implemented.

title: Admin — Resolve or Review Report

resolution_note.example: Verified the location with the owner.

response.resolution_note: Verified the location with the owner.

notes: resolved/dismissed set resolved_at; open/reviewing clear it. resolved_by comes from the admin token, not the request. Unknown report returns 404.

payload.resolution_note: Verified the location with the owner.
